# e76076f — Remove code coverage exception for generated files

- Author: Patrick Jakubowski <patrick.jakubowski@strongdm.com>
- Date: 2026-03-20

## Rationale

CI-only change. Removes a `sed` step in `.github/workflows/build_and_test.yml` that previously stripped `internal/schema/parser/cedarschema.go` from the Go coverage report. The cedar-dotnet port has no equivalent generated-parser coverage exemption (and uses its own CI pipeline), so there is nothing to mirror.

## Files touched

- `.github/workflows/build_and_test.yml`
